description:
Create a new personal hedge fund for the authenticated user.

    The fund starts inactive — call activate_fund to start Manager Mode.
    Initial capital is taken from the user's wallet_cash at creation time.
    Personal funds can ONLY contain the user's own bots — use list_my_bots
    to see eligible strategies.

    Args:
        fund_name: Display name for the fund.
        router_preset: Risk profile — one of "prudent", "standard",
                      "opportunistic", "unrestricted".
        aggression_mode: "weights" (default — the fund follows your weights
                        exactly; leftover % stays in cash) or "router"
                        (opt-in Kelly sizing; needs bots with a trade history).
        philosophy: Optional text describing the fund's investment thesis
                   (max 2000 chars).
        fund_type: "personal" (your bots + live/open-source platform bots +
                   directional bots; default), "standard" (platform bots), or
                   "open_source" (open-source bots only).

    Returns the created fund object.
name: create_fund
